reviews.conclusion: This is a cross-phase comparison, not a continuous primary run. The run finishes, credits/loading appear, then spectator/debug inspection and verification menus follow. At proxy176 s the embedded timer returns from about11:02 to04:30 and a video player is visible; later the game frame and embedded timer remain frozen while the face camera moves. The -382.2833 s inferred difference cannot be interpreted as a same-run edit. Segment playback and verify primary-source identity before timing inference.

Commentary/replay footage repeats the eye throw and shows player playback overlays, extensive game-menu holds, a temporarily rearranged/obscured capture and a death/respawn. This is not an uninterrupted primary run clock. Menus and replay behavior explain why wall time cannot simply be compared with the jolt clock; no exact -23.35 s closure is asserted.

The player pauses the embedded video while the face camera continues moving. A long freeze at proxy4.75-18 s, a shorter freeze at21.5-22 s, and settings at20-20.75 s span approximately14.5-16.0 s combined, compatible with the15.55 s deficit. This source contains active replay controls, so this is not evidence of a primary-run splice.

Commentary/replay footage visibly repeats portal travel: the on-screen run timer moves backward from about 06:41 to 06:33 at proxy 12 s. Play/pause overlays and obscured capture are visible. The -14.017 s comparison crosses replay/seek behavior and is unsuitable as an uninterrupted primary-run edit measurement.

Commentary/replay shows repeated eye throws, play/pause overlays, settings/game-menu holds and temporarily rearranged narrow game capture. The same game action is replayed. Do not interpret the -5.292 s difference as a direct edit measurement in uninterrupted primary footage.

A visible game menu spans approximately1.25-1.75 s, compatible with the1.5 s deficit. Several narrow/obscured game-window phases are recorded separately and leave precise pause-state accounting unresolved. This recording is independently known to include replay later; the local clip alone does not establish primary-source continuity.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
